name: One Simple Rule
reference: 57s dark podcast studio. A white boxed hook sits mid-screen for the WHOLE video with a small dark caption strip under it. Opens on a wide shot, then cuts between two close angles.
edit_notes:
Name-the-rule: one hard result pinned to ONE named rule, the whole rule said in one line, then why people fail and proof. The hook is a single box (hook_lines with one line, ending in a colon, e.g. "I lost the weight because I followed one rule:") and it stays on screen the entire Reel, so it must read as the title of the whole video.

Beats to keep in order: the hard number, the stakes, the rule's name, the whole rule in one line, why people fail, proof, the payoff. The rule line must be kept word for word.

Camera: full frame for the first ~5 seconds (the hard number), then tight on the face for the rule, alternating between tight (1.5) and a bit looser (1.3) at each new beat. No other effects.
